title: Transcript segment
description: One segment of a session transcript (CAP-01). A transcript is a JSON Lines file (UTF-8, `.jsonl`), one segment per line, so it can be written as a live stream of segments. Lines are in order of `start` when `secondchair transcribe` writes them; a stream may append them as they come. Protocol version 0.1.0. Any engine producing this format is accepted (`secondchair transcribe --from`), provided at least two speakers are attributed (CAP-02: single-track diarization is out of v4). A transcript is a Source: it stays outside the campaign workspace, which references it by id and hash in `sources/` (CAP-15, PKG-12). A quote's locator (CAP-04) is the transcript's Source id and the segment's `start`.

speaker.description: The Discord user who spoke, a key of the campaign's speaker table (`speakers.yaml`), which gives the player, the PC and the GM's track.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the session recording, shared by every track.

end.description: Seconds from the start of the session recording; not before `start`.

text.description: What was said, verbatim, in the language spoken.
